name: lncrnadisease

relevance.justification: Covers experimentally-supported associations between long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs), circular RNAs (circRNAs), and human/mouse diseases. Disease is a core BioThings entity type; lncRNA/circRNA are RNA-class molecular entities analogous to gene-level entities used elsewhere in BioThings (e.g. MyGene-adjacent). Not scored 5 because lncRNA/circRNA symbols are not yet a first-class BioThings entity with a dedicated resolver API (no MyGene/MyDisease xrefs shipped in the raw download files).

novelty.justification: No existing BioThings plugin or pending.api datasource covers lncRNA/circRNA-disease associations (checked references/existing-biothings-plugins.json and references/pending-api-datasources.json — no hits for lncrna/circrna/ncrna). The dataset provides evidence-level fields (validated method, dysfunction pattern, causality classification, clinical application, supporting PubMed ID) not available anywhere else in BioThings. Not scored 5 because disease names are free-text (not yet normalized to MONDO/DOID within the downloadable files, despite the paper claiming DO/MeSH mapping on the live site).

openness.justification: All core association files (website_alldata.tsv, website_simple_data.csv, website_causal_data.tsv) are directly downloadable from the datasource's own domain (rnanut.net) with no login, API key, or click-through gate — confirmed via curl with content-type text/tab-separated-values / text/csv (not text/html). Not scored 5 because the article states CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial restriction), and the live site footer shows only a generic 'All rights reserved' copyright notice with no explicit license badge — a minor license-clarity mismatch (see risks).

evidence.scope: Experimentally-supported and causal associations between lncRNAs, circRNAs, and human/mouse diseases, each linked to supporting literature (PubMed ID), validated method, dysfunction pattern, sample context, and clinical application notes.
evidence.overlap: No existing BioThings API (MyGene.info, MyDisease.info, MyVariant.info, MyChem.info, pending.api) hosts lncRNA/circRNA-disease association data. Closest adjacent resource is HMDD (already ingested, miRNA-disease, different RNA class) — no entity overlap.

license.name: CC BY-NC 4.0
restrictions: Non-commercial use only (per article license statement); live site itself shows only a generic copyright notice, not a CC badge

api_info.record_coverage: n/a — no public API documented on homepage, download page, or in the paper; bulk TSV/CSV download only

risks: Disease names are free-text strings in the downloadable files (not MONDO/DOID/MeSH-coded), despite the paper stating disease names are mapped to Disease Ontology and MeSH on the live site — that mapping is apparently web-UI-only and not exposed in the bulk download.

Confidence score (0.75-1.0, described in the paper as assigned per lncRNA/circRNA-disease pair) is not present as a column in any downloadable file — appears to be a web-UI-only computed/displayed value.
License mismatch: paper states CC BY-NC 4.0; live site footer shows only a generic all-rights-reserved copyright notice with no license badge.

Entity counts have drifted slightly from the paper since publication (paper: 6066 lncRNAs / 10732 circRNAs / 566 diseases; live download as of 2026-08-13: 5540 lncRNAs / 11309 circRNAs / 566 diseases) — files carry Last-Modified dates of 2023-09-07 (website_alldata.tsv, website_causal_data.tsv) and 2024-03-25 (website_simple_data.csv), indicating a post-publication content refresh. Disease count matches exactly, confirming correct file identification.
